definitions.explanation: Meat that has been finely chopped or ground, used in dishes like hamburgers, meatballs, and gyoza.

examples.japanese: ひき{肉|にく}を200グラム{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought 200 grams of ground meat.

examples.japanese: ハンバーグにはひき{肉|にく}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: Ground meat is used for hamburger steaks.

examples.japanese: {豚|ぶた}と{牛|ぎゅう}の{合|あ}いびきの ひき{肉|にく}で{餃子|ぎょうざ}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made gyoza with a mix of ground pork and beef.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
ひき ({挽|ひ}き, grinding) + {肉|にく} (meat) = ground meat

KANJI NOTE:
Can be written as {挽肉|ひきにく} or {挽|ひ}き{肉|にく}. The mixed form ひき{肉|にく} and full hiragana ひきにく are also common, especially at supermarkets.

COMMON TYPES:
- {豚|ぶた}ひき{肉|にく}: ground pork
- {牛|ぎゅう}ひき{肉|にく}: ground beef
- {鶏|とり}ひき{肉|にく}: ground chicken
- {合|あ}いびき{肉|にく}: mixed ground meat (usually pork and beef)
